The response body is a binary Excel workbook generated by ExcelChartGenerator.getExcelChart with ChartType.barcol, the translated chart title, series title from translation key 'charts:procurementMethod:xAxisName' (or empty if no values), categories from tender.procurementMethod, and values from totalTenderAmount.

500.description: Internal server error. The handler delegates to TenderPriceByTypeYearController.tenderPriceByProcurementMethod and ExcelChartGenerator.getExcelChart without catching exceptions; failures in those calls (e.g., MongoDB aggregation errors, translation lookup failures, or Excel generation errors) propagate as a server error.
